name: AgenticMediaBot
author: franprince
about: Notifies the Agentic Media Bot when downloads are queued and when they finish.
requirements: bash and curl must be available in the NZBGet environment (both ship with the LinuxServer NZBGet image).
The Agentic Media Bot proxy must be reachable from NZBGet at the configured WebhookUrl.
description: NZBGet has no native webhook support, so this extension provides it.
It POSTs a small JSON body to the Agentic Media Bot webhook endpoint at two points:
- when an NZB is added to the queue  -> {"event": "added",   "title": "<nzb name>"}
- when a download finishes correctly -> {"event": "success", "title": "<nzb name>"}
Downloads that end in WARNING, FAILURE or DELETED are not reported, because the bot only formats the 'added' and 'success' events.
A failing webhook never fails the download: errors are logged and post-processing still reports success.

options.name: WebhookUrl
description: Defaults to the Agentic Media Bot proxy, which relays to the bot itself - the same path Radarr, Sonarr and Plex use.
The NZBGet container runs with host networking, so localhost here is the host.

options.name: Timeout
description: Maximum seconds to wait for the webhook before giving up.
Bounded so an unresponsive endpoint cannot stall the download queue.
